recipe.text: Fresh concept: Stone Golem Sentinel - a slow, heavy melee brute distinct from prior artifacts. Native R15 block rig recolored to Slate stone with a darker head, then bulked (torso ~1.45x, arms ~1.6x, legs ~1.35x) so it reads as a hulking golem, not a blob. Added two amber neon eyes and a glowing cracked chest core (Neon + PointLight) welded to the body. make_npc configured for the brute profile: 40 damage, WalkSpeed 6, detect 24, attack range 7, cooldown 2.2s. Vision sidecar was unavailable so the confirm-capture was skipped; structure verified via get_tree and attributes read back.
